description: Use when the user needs to know whether a trend is substantive or hype before acting on it. Returns, year by year, the share of 10-K filers mentioning it (SEC EDGAR), of federal final and proposed rules (Federal Register) and of federal contract obligations (USAspending), each line's direction, and whether the three agree. If any source fails its controls the whole run refuses. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/triangulation.json
